name: Mailchimp E-Commerce
description: Integrates Drupal-based shopping carts with Mailchimp E-Commerce.
project_description: Connects a Drupal Commerce store to Mailchimp using the first-party Mailchimp Marketing API 3.x library, syncing carts, customers, products, promotions and orders so Mailchimp automations (abandoned-cart recovery, product retargeting, order notifications, customer segments) can run against live store data. The 3.x branch is an extensive rebuild of the 1.x/2.x branches: all API calls are pushed through Drupal queues so a failed Mailchimp request never interrupts the shopper, the Mailchimp store is created/updated/deleted from the admin UI, product and variation fields are mapped to their Mailchimp counterparts through an admin form, and Commerce order-workflow transitions are mapped to Mailchimp order states. Because it uses the first-party Mailchimp Marketing PHP library rather than the older Mailchimp PHP client, this branch does NOT depend on the contrib mailchimp module. Requires a Mailchimp account with an API key and a Drupal Commerce store; a single connected store is supported.
